main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The Christian cross is a spiritual key to free oneself from the temporal and material plane
header_desc: You are asleep 🧠 in an illusion ┻: Human beings harbor a free will of perception connected to the cosmos. Our left hemisphere —the psyche— is tied to the temporal and material, while the right —the pneuma— opens to the timeless and divine. Jesus of Nazareth, bearer of the primordial Consciousness, was able to perceive this; and I, the undersigned, share the same birth condition, hence my invitation to invert the map ✝️ and awaken ❤️.
left_title: The Return of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth to the Kingdom of Light
left_body: The Gnostic gospels, written almost two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity demonstrating that human existence transcends both matter and space-time. In this framework, consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ ❤️ and the material |EGO⟩ 🧠. This grants us a free will of perception that can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE | EGO⟩. In general relativity, matter tells space-time how to curve, and space-time tells matter how to move. Similarly, the ego exerts its own gravity: its density warps your internal fabric and weaves the matter-temporal illusion of the psyche 🧠. Thus, only through the wisdom of Sophia can one transcend that curvature and return to the divine and timeless plane of the cosmos, in the purity of the pneuma ❤️. Under this light, the statement "the Father and I are one" is a call to dissolve the "false self" and return to the Kingdom of pure light where the Invisible Father dwells.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation, frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is inside of you and it is outside of you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3). Pistis Sophia represents the right hemisphere, while the demiurge Yaldabaoth embodies the left, thus revealing the fundamental duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. Gravitational force drags us to a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken, and humanity will heal
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and framework of integration: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and the spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and the mind). The call to balance to initiate evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity vs. Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, the break of simultaneity by Einstein, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The Faggin--Segarra conceptual ensemble: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home, but as the soul's confinement. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas but to liberate the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and the Prison of the Demiurge (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, an egocentric god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, against Jesus' revolutionary message that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: In the end, the great paradox comes down to this: in the immensity of the cosmos—with its more than two trillion galaxies—it is there where Jesus' phrase resonates most strongly: “The Father and I are one”. Could this have had a hidden message about the deep bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a larger-than-normal white man with a flaming beard, sitting in heaven and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the sum of all physical laws governing the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn’t make much sense to pray to the law of gravity</q>
